# Hopkins MedTech Compliance

> Hopkins MedTech Compliance (HMC), operated by Hopkins MedTech Group LLC, supports medical device and in vitro diagnostic clinical performance studies, regulatory submissions, and quality systems; laboratory support is coordinated through associated businesses and partners.

## Company
- [Company information](https://hopkins-medtech.vercel.app/about)
- [Team](https://hopkins-medtech.vercel.app/about/team)
- [Contact and New York office](https://hopkins-medtech.vercel.app/contact)

## Services
- [Clinical studies](https://hopkins-medtech.vercel.app/services/clinical-study)
- [FDA and EU submission support](https://hopkins-medtech.vercel.app/services/regulatory-submission)
- [Quality systems](https://hopkins-medtech.vercel.app/services/quality-system)
- [Laboratory support through partners](https://hopkins-medtech.vercel.app/services/laboratory-services)

## Internships
- [Educational partner referral process and eight role descriptions](https://hopkins-medtech.vercel.app/careers)

Availability and individual placement arrangements are confirmed through the education partner and project lead.
